headline: Tanzania, China and Zambia ink cooperation agreement to advance, revive TAZARA prosperity
summary: Tanzania, China and Zambia agreed to modernise and revive the Tanzania-Zambia Railway Authority (TAZARA) at a trilateral meeting in Dar es Salaam. The railway is positioned as a driver of trade and investment in East and Southern Africa.
why: TAZARA is a cross-border railway linking Zambia's copper belt to the Tanzanian port of Dar es Salaam, so its revival affects regional freight, mining exports and logistics costs.
